purpose: silver_nyc_flights is the cleaned, typed flight-leg table for the January-June 2013 New York departures landed in bronze.nyc_flights (row_count 166158). It carries scheduled and actual departure and arrival times, delay and air-time measures, carrier, flight number, tail number, origin, destination and distance, and feeds downstream on-time-performance and route-level aggregates.
usage: Read one row as one scheduled flight leg, identified by time_hour, carrier, flight, origin and sched_dep_time. The four clock columns (dep_time, sched_dep_time, arr_time, sched_arr_time) are HHMM integers ranging to 2400, not minute counts, so convert deliberately before arithmetic; use hour and minute or time_hour for time-based joins. Rows where dep_time_missing is true have no actual departure, arrival or air-time values and should be filtered out of on-time averages deliberately rather than treated as zero delay.
limitations: The extract covers only months 1 through 6 of year 2013 (month distinct_values 1.0-6.0), so it is not a full year. Operational outcomes are incomplete: dep_time and dep_delay are null for 4883 rows (2.9388 percent), arr_time for 5101 rows (3.07 percent), and arr_delay and air_time for 5480 rows (3.2981 percent); tailnum is null for 1521 rows (0.9154 percent). These nulls are retained, not imputed, and the cleanup does not distinguish cancellations from diversions. The declared grain is inferred from column distinctness only; duplicate_row_rate is 0.0 for whole rows but uniqueness of the grain key set has not been measured in the profile.
